segments.t: Late Friday night after the courtyard empties, Qing and Manager Zhou are closing the front desk when Chen climbs up from the cellar carrying folding chairs—and a dusty wooden box. Listen first.
老陈，热水器后面那三把折叠椅找到了吗？
椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
一个小香柏木箱子？我在这儿十五年从没见过！
把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
让我把眼镜从额头上拉下来……九号房？！
老陈，看身后木头钥匙板：一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八！
这家客栈向来只有八间客房！九号房到底在哪儿？！
听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
第九把铜钥匙？！今晚打开还是等明天早上？！
看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
两位快拿手电筒——我的第二周现在就开始！
Now let's walk through the Season 1 finale, one line at a time.
老陈，热水器后面那三把折叠椅找到了吗？
'Chen, did you find those three folding chairs behind the water heater?' Compact furniture word:
折叠椅
combines 'fold-stack' with 'chair' for a folding chair.
椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
'Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.' Solid standing walls take
堵
as their dedicated counting word: 'one wall of old brick'.
一个小香柏木箱子？我在这儿十五年从没见过！
'A small cedar chest? In fifteen years here I have never seen it!' Strong 'never ever' pair:
从没见过
puts 'from-ever not' before 'seen-before' for fifteen years without a glimpse.
把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
'Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!' Cleaning action
擦掉
glues 'off/away' onto 'wipe' so the dust disappears from the brass plate.
老陈，看身后木头钥匙板：一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八！

'Chen, look at the wooden key board behind us: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!' Listen to all eight basic Mandarin numbers in one breath—every room number, date, and price builds straight from these eight.
这家客栈向来只有八间客房！九号房到底在哪儿？！
'This inn has only ever had eight guest rooms! Where on earth is Room Nine?!' Useful time-habit word:
向来
means 'all along' or 'always up to now'.
第九把铜钥匙？！今晚打开还是等明天早上？！
'A ninth brass key?! Do we open it tonight or wait until tomorrow morning?!' Placing the ordinal marker before 'nine' turns 'nine brass keys' into 'the ninth brass key'.
看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
'Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!' Cliffhanger compound:
暗门
pairs 'dark/secret' with 'door' for a hidden door right on the ground floor! Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
老陈，热水器后面那三把折叠椅找到了吗？
椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。

听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！

A ninth brass key, a dusty cedar box stamped 'Room Nine', and a blueprint showing a hidden ground-floor door. Season 1 of Courtyard Inn is complete—see you in Season 2.
下次见！
